```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Setup and Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 1. Data Preparation

### Raw Data Loading

```{r raw_data}
lines <- readLines("C:/Users/Dirk/Downloads/supermarket/supermarket.csv", warn = FALSE)

supermarket_raw <- tibble(
  transaction_id = 1:length(lines),
  basket = lines
)

head(supermarket_raw)
```

### Parsing

```{r parse_data}
long_data <- supermarket_raw %>%
  separate_rows(basket, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(basket = str_trim(basket)) %>%
  separate(
    basket,
    into = c("department", "time", "price"),
    sep = "\\s+"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    department = as.integer(department),
    time = as.numeric(time),
    price = as.numeric(price)
  )

head(long_data)
str(long_data)
summary(long_data)
length(unique(long_data$transaction_id))
```

### Mapping Departments

```{r mapping}
dept_map <- c(
  "1" = "Bakery & Pastry",
  "2" = "Beer & Wine",
  "3" = "Books & Magazines",
  "4" = "Candy & Chips",
  "5" = "Care & Hygiene",
  "6" = "Cereals & Spreads",
  "7" = "Cheese & Tapas",
  "8" = "Dairy & Eggs",
  "9" = "Freezer",
  "10" = "Fruit & Vegetables",
  "11" = "Household & Pet",
  "12" = "Meat & Fish",
  "13" = "Pasta & Rice",
  "14" = "Salads & Meals",
  "15" = "Sauces & Spices",
  "16" = "Soda & Juices",
  "17" = "Special Diet",
  "18" = "Vegetarian & Vegan"
)

long_data <- long_data %>%
  mutate(department_name = dept_map[as.character(department)])

head(long_data)
```

### Data Cleaning

```{r cleaning}
long_data_clean <- long_data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(department),
    !is.na(time),
    !is.na(price)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    price_per_second = ifelse(time > 0, price / time, NA_real_)
  )
```

## 2. Basket Summary

```{r summary}
basket_data <- long_data_clean %>%
  group_by(transaction_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_items = n(),
    total_price = sum(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_time = sum(time, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_time_per_item = total_time / total_items,
    price_per_second = ifelse(total_time > 0, total_price / total_time, NA_real_),
    max_price = max(price),
    min_price = min(price),
    unique_departments = n_distinct(department),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

head(basket_data)
str(basket_data)
summary(basket_data)
```

## 3. EDA - Anomaly Exploration

### Tristan: Price-Based Anomalies

#### 1. Very Low / Very High Total Price

```{r tristan_price_distribution}
# Visualize the distribution to see outliers
ggplot(basket_data, aes(y = total_price)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", outlier.color = "red", outlier.shape = 16) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Tristan: Distribution of Total Basket Price", 
       y = "Total Price", 
       subtitle = "Red dots indicate potential price anomalies")

# Isolate the extreme price baskets (e.g., bottom 1% and top 1%)
price_bounds <- quantile(basket_data$total_price, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
extreme_price_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(total_price <= price_bounds[1] | total_price >= price_bounds[2]) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_price))

head(extreme_price_baskets)
```

#### 2. Expensive Items in Small Baskets

```{r tristan_expensive_small}
# Scatter plot looking for high max_price isolated on the left side (low total_items)
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = total_items, y = max_price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "darkred") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Tristan: Max Item Price vs. Basket Size", 
       x = "Total Items in Basket", 
       y = "Max Price of a Single Item")

# Filter for baskets with 3 or fewer items but containing an item in the top 5% most expensive
high_price_threshold <- quantile(basket_data$max_price, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
expensive_small_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(total_items <= 3 & max_price >= high_price_threshold) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_price))

head(expensive_small_baskets)
```

### Hannes: Time-Based Anomalies

#### 1. Extremely Fast / Extremely Slow Scanning

```{r hannes_time_distribution}
# Visualize the distribution of average time per item
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = avg_time_per_item)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "lightgreen", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hannes: Distribution of Average Scan Time per Item", 
       x = "Average Time per Item (seconds)", 
       y = "Frequency")


ggplot(basket_data, aes(y = avg_time_per_item)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen", outlier.color = "red", outlier.shape = 16) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hannes: Outliers in Average Scan Time", 
       y = "Average Time per Item (seconds)")

# Isolate extreme time anomalies (e.g., bottom 1% and top 1% of scan speeds)
time_bounds <- quantile(basket_data$avg_time_per_item, probs = c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
extreme_time_baskets <- basket_data %>%
  filter(avg_time_per_item <= time_bounds[1] | avg_time_per_item >= time_bounds[2]) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_time_per_item))

head(extreme_time_baskets)
```

#### 2. Total Time vs Total Items Checkout

```{r hannes_total_time_items}
# Optional: Checking total_time vs total_items to see if some massive baskets were scanned impossibly fast
ggplot(basket_data, aes(x = total_items, y = total_time)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, color = "purple") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hannes: Total Time vs Total Items",
       x = "Total Items",
       y = "Total Time (seconds)")
```
